tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// 'khon lugs yang dag he ru ka'i don dbang grub gnyis 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid dang*// bde chen thig le mnyam sbyor ba'i// bla ma he ru kar btud nas// de yi dbang chog snying por dril// de'ang slob dpon chen po hūm̐ chen ka ra'i bka' srol las byon pa 'khon ston rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyi yab chos yang dag he ru ka zla gam gcig ma'i don dbang bya tshul la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo// dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su stegs bu gru bzhi bang rim gnyis par bdud rtsi lnga byugs shing me tog dgram/ steng mar dbus su thod sku dang bum pa/ shar du dril bu/ lhor rdo rje rtse dgu/ nub tu mar me/ byang du gsang rdzas/ 'og mdun du 'di'i gtor ma stod zur gsum/ smad zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba la/ ched du bsad pa ma yin pa'i sha khrag gis brgyan pa/ g.yas g.yon du sman rag dkar bdud phur srung gi gtor ma/ mtha' skor du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bcas dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod ḍa dril sogs mthong brgyud bzhin bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ yul bdag gtor ma dkar dmar gnyis bsang chus sbyangs la/ las sngags dang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ ratna bhañdza oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ hūm̐/ sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa yi// sa bdag lha klu 'khor dang bcas// gtor ma dam pa 'di bzhes la// bdag gi sgrub pa ma thon bar// khyed la gnas 'di bdag g.yar gyi// ci bde bar ni gzhan du song*// bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha/ gnang ba byin pas gzhan du dengs par mos/

rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod rdzas rnams la 'thor tshul dang*/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las bhandha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badzra ā ha ra li hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra puṣpe hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dya/ oṃ badzra shabda hūm̐/ oṃ badzra u da pa la hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bitpū ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi ta lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams= dam pa'i chos rnams= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// nyer gcig rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal// dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing gyur la// gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi// dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs// nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi// phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos// ma chags spyod la rjes yi rangs// dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do// bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la// dgos pa gsum gyis lus 'bul lo// tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun// bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo// zhes skyabs yul rnams kyi spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa dang sems bskyed bya/

sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ phyi nang snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis dpal he ru ka zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ yum khro mo dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ badzra añtsa li hūm̐/ badzra bhandha/ badzra añtsa li dzaḥ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa mang po byung ste/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ phaṭa/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams// song zhig lha min lha yang rung*// nga la bar chad byed pa'i bdud// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos// oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha nī la daṇḍa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha ya mānta ka hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha ārya a tsa la hūm̐ bandha bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hūm̐ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī hūm̐ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha trai lo kya bi dza ya hūm̐ bhindha bhindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐ spho ṭa spho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐/ khro bo rnams rang gi thugs kar thim/ yang rang gi thugs ka nas mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs byung ste sna bug nas thon/ g.yas nas bskor bas bgegs bskrad de rwa bar gyur/ hūm̐/ nga yi dkyil 'khor brtan bya'i phyir// khro rgyal byin rlabs las byung ba'i// mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin srungs// oṃ badzra a yu dha rakṣa hūm̐/

zhes dang rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sbyar mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel gung mdzub brkyangs pa'i phyag rgya bcas/ yang g.yon nas bskor te mtshon cha'i gur du gyur nas bgegs kyis mi tshugs par bsams la/ sngar gyi phyag rgya dang sngags la phaṭa bzhag pa brjod/ de nas srung ba'i 'khor lo shin tu brtan cing gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba las mthe'u mdzub gnyis rtse sprad pa rin po che'i rnam par byas pa dang*/ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas// dmyal ba'i sa gzhi yan chad kyi// log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// oṃ badzra te dza tīkṣ+ṇa tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ g.yon skor dang sngags la phaṭa bzhag pa gong bzhin/ rwa ba de dag las 'phros pa'i me'i 'od kyis bgegs thams cad bsregs par bsam zhing*/ thal mo rgyab sbyar ba'i sor mo gzhan rnams bsnol/ mthe bong rtse sprad pa dang*/ phyi rol kun tu 'od 'phros pas// bdud dpung nges par sreg byed pa// sa dang mkha' kun khyab pa yi// 'bar ba me yi phung por gyur// oṃ badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor bla ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma dang bcas pa srung 'khor gyi nang mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na maḥshrī he ru ka maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ri bhyaḥ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ mdun gyi tshogs zhing de thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs bsdus nas bdag dang dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ a la la hoḥ

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ tas bsang*/ rang gi thugs ka nas ram̐ dmar po spros pa'i mes bdud rtsi dang gtor ma'i snod la reg pas mi gtsang ba bsregs/ yam̐ spros pas rlung gi gtor/ kham̐ spros pas chus bkrus te skyon thams cad dag par byas/ bhrūm̐ spros pas bhandha 'bar ba'i snod chen por gyur/ oṃ spros pas 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs par hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥlas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa hūm̐ oṃ swā ām̐ḥhā las phyag mtshan lngar gyur/ hūm̐ badzra dhṛka oṃ dzi na dzika swā ratna dhṛka āoṃ ā ro l̥̄ kra shā pra dzñā dhṛka he ru ka yab yum bcur gyur/ sa ma ya hoḥ sbyor ba'i mes 'od du zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ du gyur/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdud rtsi bkug nas thim/ 'og gi bdud rtsi gtor ma dang 'dres nas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu hya siddhi sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ zhes bdun gyis byin gyis brlab/ rakta'i snod a las thod pa yangs par ra las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ma sūrya maṇḍa la spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ zhes bdun gyis byin brlab bo// de nas dngos gzhi bdag mdun dbyer med kyi tshul du bsgrub pa ni/

dang po rang gi sems ma bcos pa spros pa dang bral ba chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ stong pa nyid des 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab cing*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa rnams la rab tu brtse ba'i snying rje bsgom pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ thabs shes rab gnyis med rang rig gsal la ma 'gags pa de yi ge hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu gyur pa rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin te/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ hūm̐ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las ram̐ chad snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bsregs/ yam̐ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ kham̐ spros pas chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ e yam̐ bam̐ ram̐ lam̐ ram̐ kaiṃ bhrūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las yi ge de dag spros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil// yam̐ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan// de steng bam̐ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar// ram̐ las me byung bskyod pa de yi phyed// lam̐ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur// de steng rakta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs// dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng*// bde chen byang chub sems nyid gzhal yas khang*// dkar dmar mdog can zla gam sgo gcig pa// sa padma maṇḍa la/ ma sūrya maṇḍa la/ a tsand+ra maṇḍa la/ ma hā de wa dzaḥ u ma de wī dzaḥ padma nyi ma zla ba drag po pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ de babs pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus/ 'od du zhu ba las rang dpal chen yang dag gi skur gyur pa ni/ hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭ/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ hūm̐/ dbus su bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal// bcom ldan rdo rje he ru ka

/mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal// rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rnge'u chung g.yas// dril bu thod khrag rgyu zhags g.yon// rdo rje khyung gshog rab tu gdengs// mche gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar// ral pa kham pa gyen du brdzes// glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol// stag gi pags pa'i 'og pag can// dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul gyis brgyan// dbu rgyan se ral sked chings dang*// phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can// rakta zhag dang thal chen gyi// thig le zo ris tshom bur byas// sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras// zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs nas// dbang phyug kha bub mgo bo dang*// u ma'i nu ma rab brdzis shing*// ye shes me phung dbus na bzhugs// oṃ badzra kro dhi shwa rī hūm̐/ yum chen khro mo dbang phyug sngo// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje// g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob// gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can// rus pa'i rgyan lngas sku la spras// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas// sprul dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// rakta zhag dang thal chen gyis// thig le zo ris tshom bur byas// zhabs gnyis g.yas g.yon brkyangs bskum gyis// yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs// snying ga'i dbus su ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra tshon gang pa'i thugs kar rin po che zur brgyad pa'i lte bar rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyi lte ba la/ nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yungs 'bru tsam gyi mthar ru lu skra bshad kyis bris pa lta bus bskor ba/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga badzra sa mā dzaḥ

thabs kyi spyod pas sems can don// byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba// sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs par mdzod// dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /ces gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis ye shes kyi chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor he ru ka rigs lnga yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka badzra kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐/ oṃ buddha shrī he ru ka buddha kro dha shwa rī oṃ/ oṃ ratna shrī he ru ka ratna kro dhī shwa rī trām̐/ oṃ padma shrī he ru ka padma kro dhī shwa rī hrīḥ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa rī āḥ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas dpal chen yang dag lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la dam can srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdor dril bcas/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum dang*// sprul pa yang sprul bka' sdod srung ma'i tshogs// glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs nas// ye shes thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drang*/ gsal la mi 'gyur chos kyi sku// gsal med chos dbyings nam mkha' 'dra// brjod med rnam shes gzugs dang bral// 'du 'bral med pa mkha' la rdzogs// oṃ shrī he ru ka dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa ma hā su kha hūm̐/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ rtog med spros bral mkha' dbyings dag /skye med rdo rje sku gsung thugs// rang byung bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha// 'du 'bral med la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pu hoḥ pra tī dzaḥhoḥ zhes phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bdag gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdag dang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod par bsam zhing*/

sgeg phreng glu gar bdug pa me tog ma// mar me dri chab nyer spyod rol mo'i sgra// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams bkang nas// bla ma dkyil 'khor dam can srung ma la// rnam dag blo yi mos blos bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra lā sya hūm̐/ oṃ badzra mā le trām̐/ oṃ badzra gīrti hrīḥ oṃ badzra nīrti āḥ badzra dhū pe hūm̐/ badzra puṣpe trām̐/ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ badzra gandhe āḥ badzra puṣpe hūm̐/ badzra dhū pe hūm̐/ badzra ā lo ke hūm̐/ badzra gandhe hūm̐/ badzra nai bi dyā hūm̐/ badzra shabda hūm̐/ sman mchod ni/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi// rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman// rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos// ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas// rgyud lnga sems can kun grol zhing*// dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di// ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po// thugs dam dbyings nas bskul ba'i phyir// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas la// sku gsung thugs kyi ngang nyid du// bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags na// bzhes te kun tu dges mdzod la// 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī ka pā la bandha ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rgyal ba kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang*// dpal chen he ru ka dpal yab yum la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gau rī tsau rī pra mo be ta lī// sbos mo zad phod dur khrod gtum mo la// rnam dag= /thugs rje/ ma hā= /phyi nang mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thams cad dang*// ging chen bco brgyad ging phran 'bum sde dang*// dpag bsam shing lha re ma ti rnams la// rnam dag=

/thugs rje= ma hā= /shwa na mu kha bdag nyid chen mo dang*// bse yi lha mo phyogs bcu'i rnal 'byor tshogs// dam srung mched lcam bstan ma bcu gnyis la// rnam dag= /thugs rje= ma hā= drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du khā hi/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal= chos sku kun tu bzang po'i= longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'i= sprul sku padma 'byung gnas= dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi= khyad par chos skyong srung ma'i zhal du khā hi/ rang gi lce la nang mchod bzhag nas/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i// rig 'dzin bdag cag thams cad la// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// kā ya siddhi oṃ/ wāka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ rtog med spros bral mkha' dbyings dag /skye med sku gsung thugs mnga' ba// rang byung bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha// zhi khro rab 'byams 'khor dang bcas// stong nyid dbyings nas thugs dam bskul// sprul pa'i dbyings nas gshegs su gsol// dngos po mtshan mar gzung du med// rtog bral yid kyi mchod pa 'dis// dgongs pa zab mo thugs dam bskang*// chos sku'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ shrī he ru ka a mṛ ta sarba pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ḍa dril bcas/ gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang*// 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam lnga po// chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i ngang*// ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'bul// oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka ma hā ba liṃ ta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rakta'i mchod pa ni/ rakta dmar gyi arghaṃ 'di// dam rdzas khrag chen chags pa yi// ma bcos dbyings su dag bya'i phyir// dpal chen khrag 'thung zhal du 'bul// oṃ shrī he ru ka kro dhī shwa rī st+waṃ/ ma hā rakta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas 'bul/ rdor dril bcas bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/

hūm̐/ bde gshegs mnyam nyid chos kyi ngang*// ma skyes rdo rje kun tu bzang*// thabs mkhas khro rgyal skur ston pa// he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag sku la chags mi mnga'// dgyes mdzad dpal chen sku la 'khril// shes rab gnyis med bde chen rdzogs// khro mo dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// me long mnyam nyid so sor rtog /bya grub ye shes rang bzhin dang*// 'byung bzhi rnam par dag pa yi// lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal chen 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol// khams gsum chos nyid dur khrod la// nyon mongs dug gsum thams cad ni// sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor lo// tsitta mkha' mnyam rgyal po ni// kun gzhi ma bcos thig le la// rang byung ye shes sems dpa' bzhugs// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med// de nas zla gam dgu pa dang*// ye shes me dgu gcig tu gsal// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// 'bras bu sku gsung thugs su shar// dpal chen ye shes skur gsal ba// thig le chen po ye shes sku// sems nyid ma bcos rang byung gi// 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pas bstod/ de nas dzab bzlas ni/ snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs rang la thim par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐/ dpal chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni// ye shes tshon gang rin po che// thugs kyi snying po 'bru brgyad 'phros// 'od zer gsal ba kun la khyab// oṃ ni 'bar ba'i seng ge brjid// ma tshogs sprin dang skar ltar 'phro// hūm̐ chen nyi zla'i tshogs rgyun 'dra// ma nor re skong mkha' la 'gro// oṃ ni ye shes lnga dang ldan// ru ni 'bar srog chags sdang 'joms// lu ni kun bzang bde ba'i yum// hūm̐ ni ye shes tshad med bzhi// bhyo ni gnas 'gyur ma 'gags pa// hūm̐ gis byin rlabs sdud par byed// ru lu 'di ltar ya mtshan che// ru lu rtogs pa gong du 'phel// ru lu dngos grub ma lus ster// oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/

zhes yab kyi snying po dang*/ oṃ badzra kro dhī shwa rī staṃ/ zhes yum gyi snying po'ang ci rigs par bzla'o// mjug tu/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das dpal chen he ru ka'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas nas/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas bdag nyid lhar gsal ba bye ste rang gnas su 'khod par bsam mo// de nas bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su pam̐ padma maṇḍa la sogs nas/ 'khyud pas bzhugs par dang*/ rang gi snying ga sogs nas/ karma kro dhī shwa rī āḥbar dang*/ phyi mchod sgeg phreng sogs gong bzhin dang*/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi// rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman// bzhes te kun tu dges mdzod la// 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī ka pā la bandha ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes nang mchod dang*/ rdor dril bcas/ hūm̐ bde gshegs sogs yab bstod dang*/ rnam dag sogs yum bstod shlo ka re bya/ bum bzlas ni/ bdag gi zhal nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te song*/ bum pa'i lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ chags pa chen pos dgyes par rol pa'i byang sems ye shes kyi bdud rtsir babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/ yab yum gyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ gong ltar mchod bstod bya/ ru lu dang hūm̐ brjod cing me tog dkar po bum pa'i nang du 'bul zhing*/

sngags de nyid kyis spos dang bdug pa'ang dbul zhing bdug bum lha 'od du zhu/ byang chub kyi sems kyi chus yongs su gang bar bsam mo// de nas dkar bdud dang*/ phur srung la gtor chog zur nas 'byung ba ltar gtor ma phul nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod pa la/ 'o nam mkha' dang sogs nas/ gsan 'tshal bar spyi ltar dang*/ de la gang gsan par bya ba ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can des chos sku dgongs pa dang*/ longs sku brda'i tshul dang*/ sprul sku sgra tshig tha snyad kyi sgo nas 'phags pa dang so skye'i gdul bya'i yul dang 'tshams par chos kyi dbyings dang nam mkha'i khams kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i chos sgo rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpe dang tshad las 'das par bstan pa rnams kyang spang gnyen nam/ gdul yul dbang po'i rim pas rigs bsdu na rgyu 'bras theg pa gnyis sam/ snga 'gyur ba rnams la kun 'byung 'dren pa'i theg pa gsum/ dka' thub rig byed kyi theg pa gsum/ dbang sgyur thabs kyi theg pa gsum ste dgur grags pa las/ skabs su bab pa 'di ni rnal 'byor chen po dbang sgyur thabs kyi theg pa la nang gses bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po ston pa'i gzhung*/ rgyud lung man ngag gsum du rim par bzhugs pa'i dang po bskyed pa ma hā yo ga la tant+ra chen po sde bco brgyad du grags pa rtsa ba sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rgyud lnga/ sgrub pa lag len du ston pa rol pa'i rgyud sde lnga/ spyod pa'i yan lag tu 'gro ba'i rgyud sde lnga/ ma tshang ba kha skong ba'i rgyud gnyis/ spyi'i rgyud rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rnams su mchis pa las/ 'dir sgrub pa lag len tu ston pa las/ thugs kyi tant+ra he ru ka rol pa'i rgyud kyi bye brag dpal khrag 'thung galpo'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang pa/ dpal chen yang dag he ru ka la bka' srol mi 'dra ba mang du bzhugs pa las/

'dir o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas 'khon ston klu dbang srung ba la thugs dam gyi lhar stsal ba ste/ de la'ang rgyas pa zla gam dgu ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ don dbang 'bring po bya ba gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma ltar yang dag zla gam gcig ma'i don dbang bskur ba la slob dpon gyi bgyi 'os grub nas khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ thog mar zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde gshegs sras bcas dam tshig pas// yon 'bul thugs rjes bdag la dgongs// sangs rgyas sku gsum rang bzhin mchog /slob dpon mgon la bdag skyabs mchi// skal bzang lha mo'i tshogs bcas pa'i// dkyil 'khor tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// lan gsum/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal chen po he ru ka'i lha tshogs zhing nam mkha' gang bas bskor ba'i spyan sngar bsag sbyang spel gsum gyi gnad bsdus pa yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal sogs nas/ bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo bar gong ltar lan gsum/ dbang gi gzhi dgod pa ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma zla nyi lha chen po yab yum gyi steng du hūm̐ las khyed rang rnams badzra he ru ka nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad pa/ g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rnge'u chung*/ g.yon gsum dril bu dung dmar rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ yum kro dhī shwa rī ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du bzhugs par mos nas/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas dpal chen po he ru ka'i sku dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

ḍa dril/ 'bebs rdzas dang*/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ oṃ badzra kro dhī shwa rī st+waṃ la ā be sha ya btags pa lan mang du brjod/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ ye shes pa brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod/ de nas dbang dngos la bzhi las/ dang po phyi bum dbang gi slad du/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang bskur gyi lha dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra ā ha ra hūm̐/ de bzhin du dhū pe/ puṣpe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ badzra utta pha la ye hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bi sphu ra ye hūm̐/ zhes mchod/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// rdo rje'i thugs ni bla na med// skye med spros bral ngo bo nyid// mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ de rnams dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la dbang bskur bar khyed rang rnams kyis gsol ba btab par mos shig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ mdun gyi lha dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis chus dbang bskur bar mos shig bum pa mgor bzhag la/ til gyi gong bu bzhin gang ba'i// rgyal bas bum pa bzung nas ni// 'di nyid la ni dbang bskur bas// bag chags ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bum chu gtor/ spyan drangs pa'i ye shes kyi dbang lha yab yum gnyis su med par rol pa mdzad pa'i byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis bum pa yongs su bkang bas dbang bskur bar mos te/ oṃ lha yi chu ni rnam dag pas// rdo rje gsang gsum gnas las byung*// rig pa'i lha mo tshogs ldan pa'i// rang bzhin gcig tu gyur pa yin// oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes brjod pas/ dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis slob ma'i lus thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsams la/

gong ltar mchod/ nang nus pa 'jog pa'i dbang la sku'i dbang ni/ thod sku bsang sbyang*/ dbang rdzas dang slob ma mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las padma nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las dpal yang dag zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum kro dhī shwa rī ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang*/ ye shes pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yi dbang*// phyag mtshan rdo rje ka pā la// sku yi dngos grub thob byed pa// khrag 'thung yab yum dbang bskur ro// oṃ ka pā la siddhi he ru ka ka pā la a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes ka pā la spyi bor bzhag he ru ka yab yum gyi sku khyed rnams la thim/ sku snang la rang bzhin med par chu zla lta bur shes par bya'o// de ltar na sku'i dngos grub thob ste sku'i dbang ngo*// dril bu thogs la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi dbang*// shes rab gsung gi sgra sgrogs pa// mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i snying po 'di// grags stong gsung gi dngos grub thob// wā ka siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa ā/ ru lu brjod/ dril bu gtad de/ dril bu'i sgra la sems gtad nas ru lu lan gsum bzla bar zhu/ gsung grags stong skye ba med par shes par bya'o// de ltar na gsung gi dngos grub thob ste gsung gi dbang ru lu bzla ba bzlas lung dang bcas pa'o// rdo rje thogs la sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi dbang*// gnyis med ye shes skyed pa po// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin no// chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ro// tsitta siddhi badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje gtad de/ sems ma skyes rtog pa dang bral bas brjod du med pa nam mkha'i dkyil ltar gzhag par bya'o// de ltar na thugs kyi dngos grub thob ste skye ba med pa'i don rtogs pa ni thugs kyi dbang ngo*// mar mes dbang bskur ba la/ mar me bstan te/

skye med dbyings las ye shes che// sems can ma rig mun pa sel// sems nyid 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings// gsal med mar mes dbang bskur ro// oṃ badzra ā lo ke dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ dbang de nyid kyi sems nyid 'od gsal chos kyi sku thob par byed pa ste ma rig pa'i mun pa sel bar byed pa mar me'i dbang ngo*// de rnams brtan pa'i slad du bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ badzrī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bum chu 'thor zhing sbyin/ de ltar dbang bskur bas lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbur brgyan par mos shig gsang dbang gi slad du/ slob dpon dpal yang dag tu gsal ba'i gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa nor bur oṃ rtse mor phaṭa dang bcas pa phyag rgya kro dhī shwa rī mar gsal ba'i mkha' a las padma as mtshan pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3haṃ/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa mtheb srin gyis bzung nas khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu byin par mos shig thod pa'i bdud rtsi byin la/ ji ltar rgyal ba bde gshegs kyis// rang gi sras tshogs dbang bskur zhing*// byang chub sems bde dag pa'i chus// rnam rtog dri ma dag par bya// oṃ ma hā bo dhi tsitta sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de ltar byin pa'i byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi myangs la bde chen rtogs pa'i nga rgyal gzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

a ho ma hā su kha/ de na sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// bdag ni bsod nams skal ba che// yon tan kun gyis bdag brgyan te// yang dag sbyor ba'i bdag nyid do// zhes brjod la btung*/ des lus gang bas ngag gi nyes pa dag nas gsung rdo rjer gyur/ yum gyi bha ga nas gsang ba'i dbang thob pas rang byin gyis brlab pa bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ lam lnga las mthong ba'i lam sa dang po'i rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas la/ des ngag gi dri ma dag ste longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grig go /zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya kro dhī shwa rī mar gsal ba khyed rang rnams la gtad par mos shig dga' ba'i gnas chen lha mo 'di// legs par zung zhig blo gros can// dga' bde'i mchod pa rab tu gyis// thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya// 'gro ba thams cad 'di las byung*// de bas khyod kyis 'di nyid dang*// nam yang bral bar mi bya ste// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med// blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// khyed rang rnams dpal yang dag par sbyor bar gsal ba'i gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa nor bu oṃ/ phyag rgya kro dhī shwa rī mar gsal ba'i mkha' a las padma as mtshan pa/ yab kyi rdo rje nor bu'i rtsa bar rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i rtsa g.yas la oṃ dkar po/ rtsa g.yon la āḥdamar po/ dbus su hūm̐ mthing ga rtse mor phaṭa yig ser pos mtshan par gsal thob la/ 'khyud pa dang*/ tsumba dang*/ gsang gnas sbyar bas 'dod chags chen po'i mes drod skyes te dwangs ma rnams zhu/ gsang gnas mnyam par sbyar bas khams dwangs ma thams cad spyi bo nas rim bzhin 'khor lo bzhir brgyud de rdo rje'i rtsa bar phyin pas dga' ba/ dbus su phyin pas mchog dga'/

rtsa gsum 'doms pa'i dbus su byon pas khyad dga'/ nor bu'i rtse mor byon te steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyar bas mi g.yo bar gyur nas bde stong gi ye shes skyes pa la/ lhan skyes de cher 'phel bas byang sems rgyas te lte snying mgrin spyir phyin te brtan pas/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi skyes par mos la rang ngo ngos bzung bar zhu/ rdo rje snying po mkha' 'dra zhing*// rdul bral thar pa zhi ba mchog /rang gi rang bzhin de nyid do// de ltar phyag rgya gtad de bde stong gi ye shes skyes pas kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang*/ lam lnga las rgyu'i theg pa'i mthar phyin kun tu 'od kyi rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ des yid kyi dri ma dag ste chos sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grig go /zhes rtogs pa brjod/ dbang bzhi pa'i slad du/ rnal 'byor bde ba thams cad kyi// dbang bskur bde chen las byung ba// rin chen tshogs rnams thams cad kyis// rab tu myos par dbang bskur 'gyur// ji ltar snang ba thams cad kun// skad cig nyid la dmigs med pa// brjod pa'i tha snyad kun dang bral// rang byung ye shes zhes brjod do// zhes pa'i rang byung gi ye shes gsal la mi rtog pa chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin bzhi pa ste/ de la yun ring du goms pas brtan pa'i nang rtags su lus 'gul bskyod/ ngag dbugs 'gyu ba/ sems la bde sdug gang gis kyang nyon mi mongs shing bde ba chen po'i ye shes la mi 'gyur ba dang*/ phyi rtags snang ba thams cad sgyu mar shes shing mtshan 'dzin dang bral bar 'byung bas/ de la 'bad de goms par gyis shig ces brjod/ dngos gzhi khyed rang rnams lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas sngar gyi bde stong gi ye shes dran par mdzod la/

de'i ngang la mnyam par zhog cig ces brjod la mnyam par 'jog tu bcug khyed rnams kyis dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob pas lam rang byung gi ye shes phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ lam lnga las 'bras bu'i theg pa'i mthar phyin lam bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas la/ des lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag ste ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grig go /zhes brjod do// de rnams kyis dbang bskur ba grub ste rtsa ba dang yan lag gis bsdus pa'i spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag maṇḍal phul/ slar yang lus longs spyod 'bul ba'i blos/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// bdag gi lus kyang bzhes su gsol// ces brjod/ slob dpon gyis kyang*/ slob ma dam pa dam tshig che// khyod kyi 'byor tshogs shin tu bzang*// dad mos che bas dngos grub thob// dad mos med pas mi 'grub bo// zhes brjod/ dge bsngo brjod la slob ma rnams gyes so// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa kha gsos la bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod par bsam zhing*/ sgeg phreng glu gar bdug pa me tog ma// sogs/ gong bum bskyed ltar byas nas dngos grub blang ba ni/ ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// 'khor lor rab bskor zhi khro'i skur ston pa// thugs dam dbang gis bdag la brtser dgongs nas// drag po'i stobs kyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/

ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol byas te/ bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu ni// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol// bcad gtubs lus la mi 'byung zhing*// gzi mdangs nyi 'od bzhin du shog /oṃ badzra ka ba tsi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsrungs la/ rang gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāktsitta badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3haṃ/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun// bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas// khrag 'thung rgyal po he ru ka dpal gyi// 'bras bu byang chub nges par 'grub gyur cig /ces pas bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab la/ shis pa brjod pa ni/ skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnag dag las// thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi skur sprul pa// bcom ldan he ru ka dpal yab yum gyi// skye shi med pa'i don gyi bkra shis shog /ces sogs kyis shis pa'i me tog char du bsnyil bar bya'o// 'di'i sgo nas bsnyen pa bya tshul ni/ thog mar gang du bsnyen pa bya ba'i sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i sgrub khang bla ma gong ma yid ches pa rnams kyi bzhugs gnas yin pa'am/ yang na 'dre srin gdug pa can gnas pa'i sa ma yin par rang gi mdun du bla ma yi dam gyi rten gang rigs dang*/ khyad par dpal chen yang dag gi sku lugs ma'am/ bris sku rab gnas can gyi mdun du 'di'i gtor ma stod zur gsum/ smad zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba la ched du bsad pa ma yin pa'i sha khrag gis brgyan pa dbus su bzhag de'i g.yon du bandha lcang lo can gyi nang du rakta/ gtor ma'i g.yas su thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du sman phud gtsang ma/ thun gsum ga'i rjes la bsngo bya'i dkar mo'i zlum gtor/ bdud rgyal dang phur srung gi zur gsum dang*/ de rnams kyi mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bsham/

mar ngo'i brgyad dam bcu'am bcu bzhi gang rung la gza' skar drag cing shis pa'i dgong ka'i dus sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu gzhan srung ba'i tho mngon tshan can 'dzugs/ bgegs bskrad brtan bzhugs shis brjod bya/ mtshams g.yog sogs 'jug dgos rnams dmigs khongs su bcug nas bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom pa spyi ltar dang*/ rang nyid shar ram lhor kha phyogs pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs kyis blo chos dang 'dres nges su byas nas/ ngag 'don/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te/ yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ zhes pa'i bar gong dkyus bzhin dang*/ rang lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba ni/ byang khog chos kyi 'byung gnas/ nang gi dbugs ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ lus kyi drod me/ chu ser dang sha lpags chu dang sa/ rtsa sbubs kyi khrag rakta'i rgya mtsho/ sgal tshigs keng rus kyi ri rab/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa yi bu ga bzhi ni sgo bzhi/ tsitta gzhal yas khang zla gam/ srog pa rtsa sgo gcig pa/ snying tshil dkar dmar nyi zla'i gdan/ dbang po lnga mchod pa'i lha mo ste rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ spyi gtsug tu badzra he ru ka sngon po g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ mtshogs mar buddha he ru ka dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon des yu ba= rna ba g.yas par ratna he ru ka ser po g.yas rin po che/ g.yon des= ltag par padma he ru ka dmar po g.yas padma/ g.yon des= rna ba g.yon par karma he ru ka ljang gu g.yas rdo rje rgya gram/ g.yon des= dpral bar sku rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon des= mgrin par gsung rdo rje dmar po g.yas padma/ g.yon des= thugs kar thugs rdo rje sngon po g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rang 'od kyi rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas la gau rī/ g.yon la pra mo ha/ phyag g.yas dang po tsau rī/ g.yon dang po bai ta lī/ g.yas bar par pukka sī/ tha ma shma sha nī/ g.yon bar pa ghasma rī/ tha ma tsaṇḍa lī/ sgal tshigs dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ snying ga'i dbus su ye shes sems dpa' sogs nas/ bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin dang*/ de yang rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen pa byed pa'i tshe/ oṃ ni dpal chen yab yin te// badzra shes rab yum du brjod// kī li dang po khro bo bcu// kī li gnyis pa khro mo bcu// zhes kī li ya kho na la gtso 'khor thams cad tshang bar bsams pas/ bsnyen pa dang sbyin sreg bum pa 'bul ba sogs kyi sngags thams cad kī la ya kho nas go chod mdzad pa bzhin du 'dir yang mtshungs te/ dzab skul las/ ru ni 'bar srog chags sdang 'joms// lu ni kun bzang bde ba'i yum// hūm̐ ni ye shes tshad med bzhi// zhes gtso bo yab yum dang lha mo brgyad shin tu gsal bar bstan pas na/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes yang dag zla gam gcig pa'i sgrub thabs nor bu'i phreng ba las/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po gsung tshar ba'i rjes su/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni 'bum phrag bcu'o// zhes gsungs nas yum la bcu cha bzla dgos pa sogs ma gsungs shing*/ sngags 'chang chen mo'i rim pa gsal ba las/ zla gam dgu pa'i dbang du mdzad de gtso bo la 'bum phrag bcu bzlas na/ yum dang 'khor rnams la bcu cha bzla dgos par gsung ba yang*/ rgyas pa ltar na de ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med mod/ mdor bsdus shing snying po tshang la nyams len bde ba ni zla gam gcig pa'i lugs 'di kho na yin no// gang ltar thun re la ru lu khri stong la sogs pa ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar yum gyi snying po gsum sogs bzlas la thun bsdu pa na/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs nas/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag bskyed la phyi mchod sgeg phreng sogs gong bzhin dang*/

rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi// rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman// bzhes te kun tu dges mdzod la// 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī ka pā la bandha ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes nang mchod dang*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs sogs yab bstod dang*/ rnam dag sogs yum bstod bya/ snga thun srod thun gnyis la dkar bdud phur srung gi gtor ma yi ge zur nas 'byung ba bzhin phul/ 'on kyang gtor bsngo gzhan dgos na srod thun gyi mjug tu bya/ de nas dngos grub blang ba nas/ bkra shis kyi bar gong du bshad pa ltar bya'o// de ltar zla ba gcig la thun gsum gyi sbyor bas ru lu 'bum phrag bcu kha skong dang bcas pa song ba dang*/ mtshams grol ba'i nyin tshogs lhag ma bstan skyong rnams bya tshul ni/ ci 'byor pa'i tshogs phyag len bzhin bshams pa nang mchod kyis sbyangs la/ oṃ sarba dra byaṃ bi sho dha ni ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐ zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs dang*// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnams// kun bzang mchod sprin tshogs 'bul gyi// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ dang po mchod pa ni/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'di// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis brgyan// thugs dam bzhin du bzhes su gsol// dam tshig sgrub pa'i rdzas mchog 'di// bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la 'bul// longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni// chos nyid ngang la chos nyid rol// a la la hoḥbazhes su gsol// rol du gsol/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ zhes brjod cing tshogs phud gtor ma la 'bul/ bar pa bshags pa ni/ lus ngag yid kyi sdig pa rnams// gti mug dbang gis byas pa dag /'gyod pa'i sems dang bcas pa yis// lha tshogs khyed la mthol zhing bshags// de nas bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni/

rnal 'byor pa'i mdun du liṅga phyag len bzhin bshams la gu gul gyis bdugs la bzhag de dang nye bar phur pa dang ral gri yang 'du bya/ rang nyid rdo rje dril bu snying gar 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgyas bzung la/ ngag tu/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= 'jam dpal sku/ padma gsung*/ yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ phrin las phur bu/ ma mo rbod gtor/ dmod pa drag sngags/ 'jig rten mchod bstod/ 'dus pa mdo/ sgyu 'phrul rgyan/ 'chi med tshe/ lhun grub rig 'dzin/ snying po phyag rgya/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi/ bka' sdod chos skyong*/ ma mo mkha' 'gro/ dam can rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin rnal 'byor/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa yang dag pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ spyir bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ bla ma'i sku dgra/ dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra/ sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa/ khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig thang cig yud tsam la mtshan ma rdzas kyi liṅga 'di nyid la mchis par gyur cig e ram̐ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐/ he he phaṭa/ kro dha da la maṇḍa la phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing dril bu gsil/ sgo ma bzhi'i phyag rgyas bkug cing bstims pas liṅga de dgra bgegs dngos su bsams la/ de'i snying dkar nag gi mtshams su phur bu btab pas kho'i rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par bsgom/ kho'i tshe lhag rang la thim pas rang nyid tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin du gyur par bsams la/ liṅga'i rnam smin gyi lus ral gris dum bur gtubs shing*/

oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭān badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba sha trūn bighnān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing bsgral ba'i ling ro de 'dod yon lngar bsams nas/ lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du phul ba'i mos pa dang ldan pas/ bla ma la ni brnyas byed dang*// dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs// dam tshig gnyan po dral byed pa// gnod byed ma lus zhal du bstab// badzra yakṣa kro dha khā hi/ zhes brjod la ling ro gtor ma la phul bas lha thams cad mnyes te/ ha ha zhes bzhad/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes bdag la dngos grub stsal/ phaṭa phaṭa kyis dgra bgegs chos nyid du gnas spar bar bsam/ de nas mchod g.yog pas tshogs khyer la/ hoḥ bdag cag rdo rje slob dpon dang*// mched dang lcam dral ma lus pa// zhal zas tshogs la rol pa yis// mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsol// a la la ho/ zhes brjod cing tshogs la rol/ de nas lhag ma rnams bsdus la/ lhag ma za ba'i bye brag pho nya phra men ma/ 'bar ma dbang phyug ma/ ma bdun sring bzhi la sogs pa pho nya sum brgya drug cu rnams blos bkug la mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐/ de bzhin du bar gyi sngags 'dra bas/ oṃ buddha/ oṃ/ oṃ ratna/ trūm̐/ oṃ padma/ hrīḥ/ oṃ karma/ āḥ/ zhes pas gtso mo brgyad la gtor ma byin la/ oṃ utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣa si swā hā/ zhes brjod cing lhag ma la chang gi kha phru btab nas/ sarba ā na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas lhag ma btang zhing phyi rol tu dor ro// de nas bstan ma skyong ba ni/ sgrub khang gi steng ngam gnas de nyid du gtor ma dang sman rag bshams te/ rdo rje'i khyung gshog gi phyag rgya bcas la/ ho/ bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/ dpal chen po'i pham 'bab la mnos te rnal 'byor pa'i stong dang grogs la nag mo bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo bdud mo chen mo bzhi/
